cohort: 32 women with submucous leiomyomas who became pregnant after USgHIFU
finding: In patients with submucous leiomyomas, pregnancies and full-term deliveries can be successfully achieved following USgHIFU, with few related complications.
mod_finding: There were 6 (35.5%) vaginal deliveries and 11 (64.7%) cesarean sections.
